dct_description_sm: The City registers latecomer agreements for eligible infrastructure installed through development that benefits other properties and is eligible for cost recovery under Section 508 of the Local Government Act. Latecomer agreements for eligible infrastructure that is currently in design or construction are not shown.  Contact DevelopmentEngineering@kelowna.ca for more information on latecomer charges on a property.  The data is updated monthly.
